title: On-demand tabular export templates + real-time cost preview playbook
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Enable tenants (especially enterprise customers) to create, save, and run flexible tabular export templates from the Console that include: column selection, pivot/grouping presets, tenant-scoped sampling, and an instant cost preview before queuing. This ticket is the product playbook covering UX flows, backend constraints, rate limits, rollout gating, and acceptance criteria for the first public iteration (CSV/Parquet exports only).
acceptance_criteria: Users can create a custom export template selecting columns and grouping/pivots via a wizard in Console
The UI displays a real-time estimated cost for the selected template and row sample before the export is queued
Enterprise customers see tenant-aware sampling options (random sample %, time-window sampling, and customer-id anchored sampling)
Exports respect workspace RBAC and audit logging; export jobs appear in the tenant's export activity feed
Backend enforces configurable rate limits and size quotas; large exports are automatically converted to asynchronous jobs with email/console notification
We provide a short-run rollout for Dedicated customers and feature-flagged availability for Hosted tenants
Telemetry emitted: template_created, template_run_started, template_run_completed, template_estimated_cost_shown (with bucketed cost range)
tasks: PM: finalize template model (fields, pivots, sampling knobs) and publish spec to Confluence
Design: wireframes for template wizard, sample-preview, and cost preview modal
Eng (API): design REST endpoints for template CRUD, run/export orchestration, and cost estimation API
Eng (Runtime): add checks to export queue service for sampling strategies, size estimation, and job tiering
Eng (Console): implement wizard UI, cost preview call, job status list integration, and feature flag
Security/Compliance: confirm audit logging payloads and PII handling for sampled exports
QA: create test matrix for sampling strategies, RBAC scenarios, and cost estimate variance tolerance
Docs: author Console help article and export cost estimation FAQ
decision_log: 2026-02-15: Chose CSV + Parquet only for M1 to limit surface area; commercial BI connectors deferred to M2
2026-02-22: Sampling modes narrowed to three: random %, time-window, and anchored-by-tenant-id to balance reproducibility and privacy
2026-03-02: Cost preview will return a bucketed range (e.g., <$5, $5-25, $25-100, >$100) instead of precise cents to avoid over-promising accuracy
2026-03-05: Decided to expose template-level retention (30/90/365 days) to control storage costs and compliance needs
comments: 2026-02-12 - Aisha Raman: Initial write-up and goals. Pushed to scope M1 around CSV/Parquet and basic pivots. Adding cost preview as a required gating item for enterprise acceptance.
2026-02-18 - Luis Ortega: Reviewed. Need clarification on how cost estimate is computed when caching/batching is in play. Eng to propose formula and worst-case multiplier.

2026-02-26 - Priya Shah (Engineering lead): Proposed estimation approach: sample query to runtime profiler -> estimate per-row token cost -> apply batching/kv_cache multiplier => bucketed cost. Flagged edge cases for long text fields.
2026-03-01 - Design review: Wireframes approved with small UX change — move cost preview earlier in flow (before save) and include a short tooltip explaining variance.

2026-03-06 - Compliance: Confirmed that sampled exports with PII must be flagged; for tenants with PII restrictions allow only hashed-id sampling and require Data Processing Addendum (DPA) acceptance before runs.
2026-03-10 - PM: Consolidated feedback; moving ticket to Planned and scheduling a small spike for estimation accuracy (ENG-94421-spike).
